definitions.explanation: The amount of radiation a person or place receives, measured in sieverts (シーベルト). Short for {放射線量|ほうしゃせんりょう}; the word became familiar to the public after the 2011 Fukushima nuclear accident.

examples.japanese: {線量|せんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{線量|せんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Radiation levels are high in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作業員|さぎょういん}→作業員：24136_sagyouin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{線量計|せんりょうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につけ→身につく：31476_minitsuku⟧て、⟦{浴|あ}びた→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧{線量|せんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}している→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: The workers wear dosimeters every day and record the dose they have received.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {線量|せんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧・⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: high or low radiation levels
- ⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧{線量|せんりょう}: the radiation level in the air at a place
- ⟦{被曝|ひばく}→被曝：22759_hibaku⟧{線量|せんりょう}: the dose a person has been exposed to
- {線量計|せんりょうけい}: dosimeter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{放射線|ほうしゃせん}→放射線：14998_houshasen⟧: radiation itself
- ⟦{放射能|ほうしゃのう}→放射能：13035_houshanou⟧: radioactivity; in everyday speech often used loosely for radiation
